name: Porteur de sondes
description: Compact adult with thick neck, rounded powerful shoulders, speckled dark brown hide, low brow, several dreadlocks bundled horizontally at nape, exposed mandibles. Sand-cloth hood down at neck, rough cream open-sided tunic over long-sleeved fitted undergarment, reinforced bronze greaves. Carries a practical narrow bronze equipment case by one handle, other hand steadies a strapped slender sample-tube rack at hip; nothing detached. Slightly turned shoulders, idle load-carrying stance.
